source.note: The source text was extracted from the scanned Ministry of Education PDF using OCR and checked against sampled page images, including printed pages 63 and 65; the full document was not reviewed page by page. Items are grouped by numbered Content Requirements under Number and Algebra, Space and Geometry, Statistics and Probability, and Integrated Activities and Practice. Circled subclause numbers are stored in the clause field. LaTeX formulas are written as plain text; footnotes are included in the text or elective field; and clauses spanning page breaks are joined. Only Content Requirements are included, not Learning Requirements or Teaching Suggestions. Stages 1–3 were transcribed from the public 21st Century Education Network preview (http://zy.21cnjy.com/20610065) and were not checked page by page against the Ministry PDF. Stage 4 entries are unchanged. Senior-high entries are based on the 2017 General Senior High School Mathematics Curriculum Standards and have not been checked page by page against the 2025 revision. Project IDs such as cms-2017:H.<module>.<nn> are internal identifiers, not Ministry clause numbers; required and selective-compulsory modules use separate sequences.
source.page_numbering: Page references are printed page numbers in the standard. The PDF page number is the printed page number plus 7.
source.elective_note: An asterisk (*) marks elective content, not a required test item. For an item that is entirely elective, elective is true; the asterisk is retained in the clause field.
source.verbatim_policy: Verbatim text is the default (verbatim: true). Set verbatim to false when wording has been reorganized or otherwise differs from the source.
